scientific_integrity: The conclusions rely on displayed exact quadratic growth and Lyapunov decay identities; numerical evidence is not substituted for proofs. Supporting work is explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic two-by-two systems, independent squared-row-norm sampling, fixed KGSM M=1 and beta=2/3; no almost-sure divergence or general parameter-domain classification; only stated asymptotic moments are proved.
title: Orthogonal row mixing reverses mean-square stability of geometrically smoothed Kaczmarz momentum
